data.intro: Here’s what I usually take care of. If it fits in a truck and it’s safe to haul, I can probably help.

items.title: Junk Removal
items.description: General clutter, unwanted items, and cleanouts. Point it out, I’ll handle the rest.

items.title: Cleanouts
items.description: Garages, houses, storage units. Full or partial cleanouts depending on what you need gone.

items.title: Furniture Pickup
items.description: Sofas, tables, mattresses, and bulky items you don’t want to deal with.

items.title: Construction Debris
items.description: Light job site cleanup like wood, drywall, and general non-hazard materials.

note: I don’t handle hazardous waste, chemicals, paint, fuel, asbestos, or anything unsafe to transport.
Everything else is pretty straightforward. If you’re unsure, just ask.
